description: Measure Persian text: character count, word count, line count and the number of ZWNJ half-space characters. Use it to size a Persian document, enforce a length limit, or report text statistics for Persian content. Returns a stats object. ($0.005 per call, USDC on Base)

text.description: Persian (Farsi) text or value to process. Max 100000 characters.

name: fa_stats
